newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: CMS unit buys into Ultrana unit.
newsitem.headline: CMS unit buys into Ultrana unit.

text.p: Ultrana Energy and Resources Corp said on Wednesday CMS Generationa Pinamucan Ltd Duration Co, an affiliate of U.S.-based CMS Energy Corp, had acquired a 29.46 percent stake in Ultrana's Magellan Cogeneration Inc.
President Roberto Cokeng told the Philippine Stock Exchange that CMS had also entered into a shareholders agreement whereby CMS would later raise its interest to 44 percent.
The two companies further agreed that CMS will operate and maintain a power plant run by Magellan in Cavite province near Manila.
Cokeng also said that CMS will pay Magellan's obligations of 544.47 million pesos and substitute it with a $35.5 million loan from CMS Capital Corp, an affiliate of CMS.
"The balance of the loan proceeds will be used to complete the refurbishing and the expansion programme of Magellan Cogeneration Inc," he added.
